nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What is the primary purpose of ultra-processing food (UPFs) according to Monteiro et al.?
nodes.answer: The primary purpose of ultra-processing food is profit, relying on cheap commodity ingredients and processing technologies to minimize costs while using branding and marketing to drive sales.
nodes.paragraph: 2022). According to Monteiro et al., the purpose of ultra-processing food is profit the business model relies on using cheap commodity ingredients and processing technologies to minimise cost, and emphatic branding, intensive marketing and product designs to drive sales and normalise consump- tion; features that make UPFs liable to displace all other foods in human diets (Monteiro et al. 2019). Corporations that manufacture and distribute UPFs have indeed become the most profitable in the food system, generating growing returns to their shareholders located near exclusively in the Global North (Wood et al. 2021, 2023a). Some countries, especially those in Latin America, have adopted world-leading policy responses to tax, limit the availability and restrict the marketing of UPFs (Popkin et al. 2021). Yet, elsewhere policy responses to this issue have so far been weak or are only emerging, akin to where tobacco control responses were decades ago. Many reasons have been put forward for this inertia, but among the most impor - tant is the growing economic and political power of the UPF industry.

nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What is the purpose of finding the values for T and AWAY by equating the first-order partial derivative of Equation (13) to zero with respect to the parameters T and AWAY?
nodes.answer: The purpose of finding these values is to optimize the total profit of the supplier by determining the most efficient cycle time T and circularity index AWAY.

nodes.label: Science and Tech
nodes.question: What is the significance of bi-objective optimization in a three-echelon multiserver supply-chain problem in congested systems?
nodes.answer: Bi-objective optimization in a three-echelon multiserver supply-chain problem helps in maximizing efficiency and reducing congestion in the supply chain network while also minimizing costs and resource utilization.

nodes.label: Taxonomy
nodes.question: What are the main components of the four "tiers" commonly distinguished in the supply chain?
nodes.answer: The four "tiers" in the supply chain are Tier 1 for finished product assembly, Tier 2 for manufacturing subcomponents, Tier 3 for processing raw materials, and Tier 4 for cultivation, farming, or extraction of raw materials.

nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What is the significance of market uncertainty in distributing and transporting fashion goods?
nodes.answer: Incorporating stochastic market demands helps in better predicting and adapting to fluctuations in demand, leading to more efficient transportation and logistics strategies in the fashion industry.
